description: Make a dimensioned technical drawing of a finished AI CAD part (a project_id from text_to_cad or drawing_to_3d): the exact model drawn from every side with its measured sizes, holes and radii, drafted as an ISO A3 sheet. One to two minutes; the PNG is saved to disk and its path returned, and the drawing is saved to the user's TechDraw AI projects for editing. Costs 5 credits and requires the Studio plan.

output_path.description: Where to save the PNG. Defaults to ./techdrawai-output/cad-drawing-<timestamp>.png.

name: cad_to_drawing
title: Draw an AI CAD part as a technical drawing
